from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
import pandas as pd

# Load the workbook
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53161/1_53161_input.xlsx'
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/53161_3_8c3ecb99/1_53161_output.xlsx'

# Read the data
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)

# Extract Agent Categories table (rows 3-8, cols 4-13)
# Row 2 has headers: Agent, Category 1, Category 2, ..., Category 9
agent_names = df.iloc[3:9, 4].tolist()  # Alexis, Alycia, Taylor, Edi, Brittany, Amy
category_headers = df.iloc[2, 5:14].tolist()  # Category 1 through Category 9

# Build agent_categories dictionary: {agent_name: {category: value}}
agent_categories = {}
for i, agent in enumerate(agent_names):
    if pd.notna(agent):
        agent_categories[agent] = {}
        for j, category in enumerate(category_headers):
            if pd.notna(category):
                value = df.iloc[3+i, 5+j]
                agent_categories[agent][category] = 1 if value == 1 else 0

print("Agent Categories:")
for agent, cats in agent_categories.items():
    print(f"{agent}: {cats}")

# Extract Agent Schedule table (rows 12-17, cols 5-30)
# Row 11 has time headers starting from col 5
time_intervals = df.iloc[11, 5:31].tolist()
schedule_agents = df.iloc[12:18, 4].tolist()

# Build schedule dictionary: {time_interval: [list of agents scheduled]}
schedule = {}
for j, time_interval in enumerate(time_intervals):
    if pd.notna(time_interval):
        schedule[time_interval] = []
        for i, agent in enumerate(schedule_agents):
            if pd.notna(agent):
                value = df.iloc[12+i, 5+j]
                if value == 1:
                    schedule[time_interval].append(agent)

print("\nSchedule (first few intervals):")
for i, (time, agents) in enumerate(schedule.items()):
    if i < 3:
        print(f"{time}: {agents}")

# Now calculate the category counts per time interval
# Answer position F22:AE29 is rows 21-28, columns 5-30
# Row 21 is Category 1, Row 22 is Category 2, ..., Row 28 is Category 8
# (Note: Category 9 is not in the answer range)

categories_to_calculate = ['Category 1', 'Category 2', 'Category 3', 'Category 4', 
                          'Category 5', 'Category 6', 'Category 7', 'Category 8']

# Calculate results
results = {}
for category in categories_to_calculate:
    results[category] = []
    for time_interval in time_intervals:
        if pd.notna(time_interval) and time_interval in schedule:
            count = 0
            for agent in schedule[time_interval]:
                if agent in agent_categories and category in agent_categories[agent]:
                    count += agent_categories[agent][category]
            results[category].append(count)
        else:
            results[category].append(0)

print("\nCalculated results (first 5 intervals):")
for category in categories_to_calculate[:3]:
    print(f"{category}: {results[category][:5]}")

# Load workbook with openpyxl and write results
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Write results to F22:AE29 (rows 22-29 in 1-indexed, cols F-AE which is 6-31)
for i, category in enumerate(categories_to_calculate):
    row_idx = 22 + i  # Starting from row 22 (1-indexed)
    for j, value in enumerate(results[category]):
        col_idx = 6 + j  # Starting from column F (6 in 1-indexed)
        ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx, value=value)

# Save the workbook
import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

print(f"\nFile saved to {output_path}")
